bio: Biscuiteers is famous for making beautiful hand-iced biscuit gifts and now you can enjoy an indulgent Afternoon Tea at Biscuiteers Belgravia.  Please note that the traditional offering will be replaced with the Festive Afternoon Tea between 1st November until 31st December. More info and menu details here .  Located in the beautiful urban oasis of Eccleston Yards, just minutes from the hustle and bustle of Victoria, Biscuiteers Belgravia has its signature illustrated shop-front and black and white awning.  Afternoon Tea at Biscuiteers Belgravia features a luxurious selection of delicate finger sandwiches, exquisite pâtisserie, freshly baked scones and their signature hand-iced biscuits. Afternoon Tea is served with a bespoke blend of Tregothnan tea, and for those special occasions, why not include a glass of Biscuiteers fizz? The perfect pairing for an afternoon to remember.  Afternoon Tea costs £45 per person, or £51 per person with a glass of Prosecco.  For an extra special experience, you can now book to enjoy DIY Icing with your Afternoon Tea - the perfect pairing for an afternoon to remember. Whilst you enjoy our signature tea you’ll enjoy a DIY Icing Experience and will be provided with everything you need to make your own biscuit masterpieces to take home.  The Afternoon Tea and DIY Icing experience is priced at £65pp.
